basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 18.' and it opens 'Vers. 18. Ab Hevila. Id est ab India. Coram cunctis fratribus obiit. Id est in manibus'. The chapter is Migne's caput, carried from the last one the printing states, and the lemma raises nothing against it.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 18. Ab Hevila. Id est ab India. Coram cunctis fratribus obiit. Id est in manibus fratrum suorum, omnibus videlicet adhuc superstitibus, | et nullo ante eum morte praerepto. Fratres autem pro filiis posuit, sicut et eo loco ubi in sequentibus Jacob dixit ad Laban: Quid peccavi tibi, ut insequereris post me? Pone coram fratribus meis et fratribus tuis. Neque enim Jacob ibi alios fratres habebat quam suos liberos.
